turns.question: What was the median gap in hours between consecutive orders of the same customer in September 2026, counting only customers with at least two orders?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median gap in hours between a customer's consecutive orders, so I cannot give a figure for September 2026. The closest metrics are Orders (orders_total), Repeat customers (repeat_customers) and Active customers (customers_distinct), which count orders and customers but not the time between them; no query was run, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
